components.name: Next-prayer surface
components.description: 154 logical-unit tonal rectangle: bold prayer name, 38-unit countdown, Time remaining caption and exact start beside the 104-unit day dial. Dimensions use Style.space.

components.name: Prayer row
components.description: Rectangle delegate: height Style.space(44), radius Style.cornerRadius; right-aligned Style.space(56) time column.

components.name: Next prayer row
components.description: Next prayer uses accent text, bold name/time, localized model status and accent alpha 0.12 fill, increasing to 0.22 when imminent.

components.name: Day dial
components.description: Small adjacent 104 logical-unit Canvas with event-driven painting and real 24-hour fractions; exact next start sits at its center.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Row of native PanelActionButton minus/plus and centered PlainLabel value.

components.name: Theme controls
components.description: Reuse qs.Ui Button, Toggle, Dropdown, SearchableDropdown, ButtonGroup and TextField with live foreground/accent/fontFamily.

components.name: Bar widget
components.description: qs.Ui WidgetButton with native active imminent state and three mouse-button actions.

components.name: Location and calendar settings
components.description: Native worldwide city search with busy, empty and connection feedback; ±2-day Hijri stepper; labeled unmirrored latitude/longitude fields and validated offline Apply coordinates action.

narrative.overview: A compact native prayer timetable that belongs to the current Omarchy desktop. The next prayer and explicit time remaining lead inside a tonal rectangle; a small adjacent day ring provides context. Its arc represents the current prayer window. The theme supplies the font, foreground, surface, and accent.
keyCharacteristics: Aligned times with explicit next-prayer emphasis
Flat tonal surfaces and restrained motion

rules.name: The Theme Rule
rules.body: Preserve dynamic theme expressions; a screenshot’s colors are evidence of one theme, not a new palette.

dos: Do preserve live Omarchy theme bindings.
Do keep Arabic labels readable and numeric times unmirrored.
Do show the next prayer and its exact time before settings.
donts: Don’t introduce a fixed palette or bundled display font.
Don’t add glow, ornamental clock motion, or a reveal that delays prayer data.
Don’t replace native shared controls with web approximations.
